title: Standard Action
description: A comprehensive schema for character actions with narrative integration, LLM-GM guidance, and enhanced mechanics.

name.description: The display name of the action.

action_type.description: The primary category of the action.

era.description: The primary era this action is most associated with, e.g., 'Galactic_Republic', 'Galactic_Empire', 'New_Republic'.

narrative.description: Rich narrative description of the action, its significance, and role in the galaxy. Used by LLM-GM for storytelling.

flavor_text.description: Iconic quote, description, or memorable phrase that captures the essence of this action.

cultural_significance.description: Description of how this action is viewed and valued by different cultures and groups in the galaxy.

description.description: Tooltip text explaining the action's rules and outcomes.

action_process.description: Detailed step-by-step description of how the action is performed.

origin_story.description: The history and origin of this action technique or method.

connections.description: Universal connections to any game object - factions, species, classes, locations, etc.

target_id.description: ID of the target object (faction, species, class, location, etc.).

target_type.description: The type of object being connected to.

relationship.description: The nature of the relationship, e.g., 'Developed By', 'Common Among', 'Restricted To', 'Iconic To', 'Enhanced By'.

narrative.description: Description of how these objects are connected.

mechanical_benefit.description: Optional mechanical benefit from this connection.

iconic_examples.description: Famous or notable examples of this action from Star Wars canon.

famous_users.description: Notable individuals who have mastered this action.

famous_instances.description: Notable events or moments involving this action.

narrative_hooks.description: Story hooks and narrative elements related to this action.

adventure_seeds.description: Potential adventure ideas that could involve this action.

character_connections.description: Ways characters might be connected to or affected by this action.

typical_usage.description: Examples of how this action is typically used in Star Wars stories.

cultural_impact.description: How this action affects the cultures and societies of the galaxy.

tactical_significance.description: The tactical implications and significance of this action.

cost.description: The types of action resources this can be spent on.

target.description: Defines the targeting parameters for this action.

type.description: The type of target this action can affect.

conditions.description: Additional conditions that must be met for targeting.

skill_check.description: Optional skill check requirements for this action.

skill.description: The skill required to perform this action (e.g., 'Technology (INT)', 'Persuasion (CHA)').

dc_type.description: Type of difficulty class for the skill check.

value.description: Fixed DC value for the skill check.

opposed_by.description: Skill that opposes this check (for opposed_check type).

effects.description: The mechanical results of taking the action, using our master effects schema.

narrative_outcomes.description: List of IDs for valid Advantage/Threat spends when using this action.

image_generation.description: Data source for modular AI art generation engine.

base_prompt.description: Detailed foundational prompt for generating a 'stock image' of this action, with bracketed placeholders for customizable parts.

contextual_modifiers.description: Modifiers defining how this action adds flavor and context to other image prompts.

target_type.description: The type of image this modifier applies to (e.g., 'Character_Portrait', 'Combat_Scene', 'Location').

modifier_text.description: Text to append to the base prompt when this action is part of the context.

ui.description: User interface assets and display information.

image.description: Path to the action's representative image.

icon.description: Path to the action's icon for UI display.

themes.description: Thematic elements associated with this action.

mood.description: The emotional tone or atmosphere associated with this action.
